title: Derived pullback between independently chosen localization universes
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independently chosen derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Compare each localization with the standard localization by Localization.uniq applied to Qh and the quasi-isomorphisms of complexes. Define Lf* between the specified categories as the equivalence on Y, followed by the recorded standard K-flat derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], followed by the inverse equivalence on X. This is an actual composite of functors, with no existence witness selected as its data.
